Anya (PM): Short thread to decide minimal acceptance for BYOK + retention v1. Need defaults and a small pilot plan.
Ben (Eng): Propose defaults: audit=2y, metadata=1y, payloads=90d. Implementation: retention_tag on write + lifecycle job.
Ruth (Security): Must require signed manifest for exports and HSM-backed signing key. BYOK modes: customer-KMS (no plaintext) or escrow-wrapped with explicit consent.
Hector (Legal): Consent must be explicit in contract. Draft line: 'Customer consents to escrow-wrapped key retention solely for export; revocation requires 30 days'.
Nia (CS): Pilot ask: console "legal hold" toggle and an export preview for customers to validate. Need clear pricing note for long retention.
Ben (Eng): Tech gating: manifest spec, index plan for metadata, cold-archive pipeline for long retention. Need one infra sprint for lifecycle.
Ruth (Security): Add requirement: audit trail of who toggled holds preserved and immutable.
Anya (PM): Launch criteria: 1) manifest spec published; 2) BYOK opt-in flow documented; 3) Console hold + preview; 4) 2 pilot exports successful; 5) runbook published.
infra-bot: RFC uploaded: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/3345678901 (draft)
Anya (PM): Action items: Ben - stub RFC + index plan (EOW). Ruth - escrow spec + threat model (EOW). Hector - consent language (EOW). Nia - pilot list (3 days). Next sync in 1w.
